## Overview

aberson-profile brand - extends the shared on-brand house-docs preset, with a LOCAL indigo brand-ramp override (seed #3730a3, generated via on-brand buildBrandRamp). Only color.primitive.brand + color.semantic.accent are overridden here; neutral/status/chart/diagram stay inherited from house-docs. The diagram palette (color.diagram) still lives in exactly ONE place (on-brand/templates/presets/house-docs); this project inherits it wholesale. The README <picture> core-pipeline SVGs under assets/ are regenerated from brand/dist/diagram-palette.json by scripts/regen-diagrams.mjs.

This file is generated by on-brand from `brand/tokens.json` (light values) and
`brand/modes.dark.json` (dark-mode color overlay). Do not edit it by hand;
regenerate with `onbrand build`. The YAML front matter above carries the
machine-readable token maps; the tables below are the complete token set.
When writing code, prefer importing the sibling `brand/dist/` outputs over
copying raw values from this document.

## Colors

Front-matter `colors` keys are the source token paths below with the leading
`color` group dropped and dots replaced by hyphens.
The front-matter `primary` entry aliases `color.semantic.accent`.

- `color.primitive.brand` - Indigo brand ramp (OKLCH seed #3730a3), 12 steps light-to-dark. Local override of the inherited house-docs blue ramp; regenerate with on-brand buildBrandRamp, not by hand.
- `color.primitive.neutral` - Cool-gray neutral ramp, 12 steps light-to-dark.
- `color.chart.categorical` - Eight intentionally related, indigo-led series colours: cool brand relatives first, then muted signal accents for chart distinction.
- `color.chart.sequential` - 7-step light-to-dark sequential ramp derived from the brand hue.
- `color.diagram` - Lifted EXHAUSTIVELY from the hand-baked diagram SVGs (light variant): claude-skills/_shared/{core-pipeline,improve-skills,routing-web}-light.svg + aberson-profile/assets/core-pipeline-light.svg. Every distinct color the source art uses for a diagram role has a key here, so Pass 2's regenerated SVGs source every fill/stroke from diagram-palette.json. Role -> SVG class: canvas=.bg fill; canvas-border=.bg stroke (softer frame, also the dashed section-divider line) — deliberately softer than node-stroke; node-fill=.node/.rail/.innode rect fill; node-stroke=.node rect stroke; link=.lnk/.fan stroke + arrow marker; spine-accent=.spine/.fork/.pn/.rail-name/.gw-cmd + chip stroke + spine arrow; label=.lbl/.ps/.cap/.rail-dest/.title/.chip-lbl muted text; title-strong=.hub-t (near-black hub title); text-muted=.in-t (mid-gray node text); chip-highlight=.chip rect fill; warning=.rail-sub (routing-web annotation-emphasis subtext — the canonical §4 color.diagram key name is kept, though the source usage is emphasis, not an alert).

## Dark Mode

Dark values come from `brand/modes.dark.json`, a color-only overlay over
`brand/tokens.json`. The Dark column in the Colors table shows the effective
dark value for each overridden token; tokens without a Dark entry keep their
light value in dark mode. The DESIGN.md format has no mode concept, so this
extension section documents the convention.
